card.name: Inside Italian-style surnames
card.fires_on: Pieces of Italian or Romance personal names and surnames, especially the ending of names like Sangallo, Ullo, McCulloch, Longo, or a first name like Angelo or Carlo, in biographical or citation text.

modes.label: Surname endings
modes.description: The closing piece of a surname split into parts, such as -allo, -lo, -ullo.

modes.label: Italian first names
modes.description: An Italian first name that comes just before a surname.

card.plain: It lights up on the later part of Italian-sounding names, like the end of Sangallo, in biographies and reference lists.
